svg.title: Technical architecture — Trackback
svg.text: A graph with memory and guardrails.
One Python service hosts the demo API, time-pinned documents and built frontend.
Replay uses cached or local responses; external model calls require record mode.
Tailwind CSS 4 · React Flow + Dagre · Stage / Deep / Scorecard / Lyft reconstruction
API: corrections, graph, approvals, lessons, snapshots.
Protocol routes: pings, challenges and SSE events.
Memento routes /r · /tg · /m · /tm. Reads bind to the run’s
Formula evaluation · version graph · verified receipts · bounded rework
Approvals → freshness / figure fence → simulated effect
Cache keys include the pinned corpus.
SHARED SQLITE · VERSIONED EVIDENCE + EVENT HISTORY
Sources / claim versions · artifacts / justifications · consumption receipts
Runs / reads · waves / pings / outbox · approvals / ledger / effects · lessons · LLM cache
Offline builders restore the canonical snapshot; evaluation scripts compare against YAML answer keys.
Also implemented: stdio MCP read tools, Docker/Fly configuration and a Vercel entry with a /tmp database.
MCP/A2A notification adapters and a second domain pack remain future work.
Mark the first boundary to change for multiple concurrent customer sessions.
